questions.q: In Genesis 5:1-2, who are the 'male and female' that the Most High called Adam?
choices: The other people on the earth
questions.explain: Made he him is the first Adam; male and female created he them are the other people on the earth.

questions.q: Whose lineage is laid out in Genesis 5?
questions.explain: Chapter 5 is the direct lineage of Adam, the sons of God of chapter 6. Luke 3 runs Christ's lineage back through Seth to Adam.

questions.q: What does 'Enoch was not; for God took him' mean?
choices: Enoch was taken up and did not taste death, like Elijah
Enoch left the line of Adam
questions.explain: The Most High took him up; Elijah was likewise taken up by a whirlwind (2 Kings 2:11).

questions.q: About how long did Noah preach before the flood?
questions.explain: Noah was five hundred years old here and six hundred when the flood came.
